result.summary: The image shows a food delivery application interface. The main visual issue is the incomplete layout of the bottom-most restaurant card (likely a pizza place), which is cut off vertically, making it appear broken or poorly aligned with the screen's viewport.

issues.description: The bottom-most restaurant card (the pizza entry) is partially cut off, indicating an incorrect container size or scrolling behavior.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or height constraints of the scrollable area to ensure the last item is fully visible above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'See all' links for 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' have a very low visual hierarchy and may be difficult to identify as actionable buttons.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font weight or use a distinct brand color for the 'See all' text to improve call-to-action visibility.
